dogecoin.text:
Interestingly, over the last 90 days, the % of accounts in a long in $DOGE are in the 96th percentile (!)

Despite the minimal 24-hour change in Long%, there's a noticeable decline in Open Interest. https://t.co/c8YZtsTQlp

On lower timeframes, "FOMO" can be identified by detecting a simultaneous spike in net longs and slippage within the same candle.

For $DOGE, such a spike in both slippage and net longs marked the local top, which was subsequently followed by a price drop. https://t.co/3luDfDuncK
$DOGE looks ready to eat up that short liquidity, especially as the cluster above it continues increasing. https://t.co/nzioJ0KLlt
